The '''Kashyyyk Medal of Freedom''' was an award that created by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and awarded to any individual that fought for the freedom of the planet. It resembled a bronze and gold starburst that was suspended from a silver ribbon studed with clear stones.

It was given to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] by [[Gursan Bryes]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], for defeating [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cyssc Blackscale]].
